clean_description: In the canton of Yarrowdale, a Treasury officer mysteriously disappears from a locked room, prompting the Empire to enlist the help of the brilliant detective Ana Dolabra. As she investigates, Ana uncovers a murder plot involving a cunning adversary who can bypass magical wards. The stakes rise when the killer targets a high-security compound that is crucial to the Empire’s magical power.
setting: fantastical empire on the edge of civilization
